title: Kundalini Tide Oracle
description: A surreal scene depicts a green-skinned, three-faced figure in pink and green robes standing behind a wooden desk, reading a book. An orca whale with glowing lanterns hanging from its body emerges from the right, while another orca falls upside down from a circular portal in the ceiling emitting beams of light. A large swirling red and green vortex with skulls and dripping patterns fills the left background.
prompt: Surreal mystical scene featuring a green-skinned three-faced humanoid in ornate pink and green robes standing at a wooden desk with books and glowing orbs. A large orca whale with hanging blue lanterns on its body emerges from the right side. Another orca falls upside down from a bright circular portal in the ceiling with dramatic light beams. Left side shows a large swirling red and green spiral vortex decorated with skulls and dripping green patterns. Dark mystical atmosphere with red patterned curtains on the right.
